_note: The farmer's refined pixel art (FigureArt with farmer = true; the villagers and the child have the same pass with their own numbers in data/villager_art.json). Every material of the look (hair, skin, the noragi, its collar band, the monpe, the head cloth, the jika-tabi, the straw of the belt and hip basket) is drawn in three tones, lit from the upper left: a part's pixels open to the upper left take the lit tone, those open to the lower right the shade tone. Lines between parts are the material's own deep tone, not black; the outer silhouette is that deep tone pulled further towards `rim`. Our own numbers.
